summary: Pair sampler: per-query candidate strata (baseline top-K, edge partners, hard negatives, random) to pairs.jsonl
description: tools/scorer_pairs.py, EDGE_GURU_ROOT-aware (guru worktree; never branch-switch the main checkout). Strata per query: baseline retriever top-K (positive-rich), anchored edge partners (the operational stratum, via inherited_partners), hard negatives (high vector-cosine chunks NOT retrieved), random floor. Cap per query per spec. Skip chunks in the known-apparatus list (guru-web todo:6e0c2a63 roll-up) for positive strata only. Output rows carry stratum + provenance for later analysis.

resolution.note: 10,825 training pairs (baseline 7061 / hardneg 2598 / random 1039 / edge 127) from 520 queries; 1,830 frozen-eval pairs from 89 frozen-work queries. Bodies embedded at judged truncation (2400 chars); apparatus excluded from positive strata.
